title: _sanitize_value cycle guard and fail-closed placeholder for autolog serialization
answers: crewai autolog infinite recursion Agent Crew cycle
what does crewai sanitizer return on error
why does crewai trace show omitted sanitization failed
agent.crew circular reference in crewai trace
body:
Invariant: _sanitize_value walks pydantic models recursively, so it must keep a reference-cycle guard. Agent.crew -> Crew.agents -> Agent is a real cycle, and the back-reference is replaced by the class name string "Agent".
Fail-closed: if walking a value raises, _sanitize_value returns the placeholder "<dict: omitted, sanitization failed>" instead of the raw value, so a sanitizer error cannot leak the original object into the trace.
Enforced in: mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_sanitize_value, covered by tests test_sanitize_value_handles_reference_cycles and test_sanitize_value_fails_closed_when_sanitization_raises in tests/crewai/test_crewai_autolog.py.
Breaks if skipped: infinite recursion on Agent/Crew graphs, or raw credentials emitted when a sanitizer error is swallowed.
applies: Applies to any change to the recursive sanitizer or to new CrewAI object types that are attached to spans.
says: Agent run tracing freezes indefinitely when logging multi-agent workflows with mutual references.
Traces display an omitted sanitization failed message instead of capturing the agent output.
Prevent automated tracing from leaking sensitive credentials into execution traces when serialization fails.
Trace logging hangs on infinite loops when recording interactions between agents and crews.
Show sanitized placeholders in the trace viewer whenever scrubbing agent run metadata fails.
search: _sanitize_value in mlflow/crewai/autolog.py must maintain a reference-cycle guard when recursively walking Pydantic models and fail closed on errors. Circular references like Agent.crew to Crew.agents to Agent replace the back-reference with the string 'Agent' to prevent infinite recursion. If value walking raises, it returns the placeholder '<dict: omitted, sanitization failed>' to prevent leaking raw objects or credentials into traces, applying to sanitizer changes and new CrewAI span objects.
